001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.inventory;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.AbstractQSEvent;
004import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
005import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
006
007/**
008 * Called for each individual item being delivered during a shop transaction.
009 */
010public class ShopItemDeliveryEvent extends AbstractQSEvent {
011
012  @NotNull
013  private ItemStack item;
014
015  /**
016   * Creates a new ShopItemDeliveryEvent.
017   *
018   * @param item the item being delivered (single unit, amount will be 1)
019   */
020  public ShopItemDeliveryEvent(@NotNull final ItemStack item) {
021    this.item = item;
022  }
023
024  /**
025   * Gets the item being delivered.
026   *
027   * @return the item
028   */
029  @NotNull
030  public ItemStack getItem() {
031    return item;
032  }
033
034  /**
035   * Sets the item to be delivered. Use this to modify the item before delivery.
036   *
037   * @param item the modified item
038   */
039  public void setItem(@NotNull final ItemStack item) {
040    this.item = item;
041  }
042}
